title: Find the nationality that has the most drivers who achieved a Q2 qualifying
question: Find the nationality that has the most drivers who achieved a Q2 qualifying time faster than 1:20 in races held at circuits located in Europe between 2008 and 2012.

prediction.sql:

FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races r ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065
JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
WHERE r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012
  AND c.XCL_005 IN ('France','Spain','UK','Portugal','Italy','Germany','Belgium','Austria','Switzerland','Sweden','Netherlands','Monaco','San Marino','Hungary','Turkey','Russia','Estonia','Latvia','Lithuania')
  AND q.XCL_063 IS NOT NULL AND q.XCL_063 != ''
  AND (CAST(SUBSTRING(q.XCL_063, 1, INSTR(q.XCL_063, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
     + CAST(SUBSTRING(q.XCL_063, INSTR(q.XCL_063, ':') + 1, INSTR(q.XCL_063, '.') - INSTR(q.XCL_063, ':') - 1) AS REAL)
     + CAST(SUBSTRING(q.XCL_063, INSTR(q.XCL_063, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) < 80
GROUP BY d.XCL_041
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT d.XCL_034) DESC
LIMIT 1
